name: Blight Emissary AI
body:
Blight Emissary AI CR 14

XP 38,400
CE Medium construct (artificial intelligence)
Init +11; Senses hostleap 30 feet, Perception +16

DEFENSE

Fort +4, Ref +4; Will +11

STATISTICS

Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 18
Skills Autohypnosis +16, Bluff +18, Craft (Mechanical) +21, Disguise +18, Knowledge (arcana) +21, Knowledge (engineering) +21, Knowledge (planes) +18, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +21
Feats Deep Focus, Improved Initiative, Psionic Meditation, Psionic Shot, Speed of Thought, TechnologistB, Unlocked Talent, Wild Talent
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Binary, Common, Draconic
SQ Adaptive Mechanisms, Hostleap, Machine-Lord’s Communion 7

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adaptive Mechanisms (Su)

A blight emissary AI can store itself in extradimensional space in order to hide away in even simplistic machinery. A blight emissary can be stored inside a technological device as simple as a battery, but usually seeks to move to a more suitable host machine as quickly as possible using its hostleap ability. Whenever the blight emissary AI enters a new body, it may change the power it is granted by the Unlocked Talent power.

Hostleap (Su)

A blight emissary AI detects all technological devices within 30 feet as per the Technomancy spell. This sense is precise enough to identify specific devices or creatures that the blight emissary could inhabit. As a full-round action, the blight emissary AI may inhabit a technological device or creature within 30 feet so long as the device or creature could accept an AI.

Machine-Lord’s Communion (Su)

A blight emissary AI remains in constant telepathic communication with Imledoth from any range.

ABOUT

Twelve tentacular limbs of glistening metal extend outwards from a spherical core, each appendage ending in a bubbling mass that continually reshapes itself. The reflective central body periodically flashes with multicolored light as pulses of energy crackle across the entity’s form.
